decisions.reason: The air quality sensor module fits the firm's modular building-block system and its own sensor and firmware expertise, and it was presented on its own page in both years, so the firm can keep developing it.
As the third generation of an established measurement module, it rests directly on accumulated in-house knowledge and is likely to stay until a successor replaces it, as happened with version 2.0.
The CAN bus interface extends the firm's existing communication module know-how and serves industrial users, so the firm can interpret demand for it and improve it.
The CO2 sensor module complements the air quality line, uses the same sensor-integration competence, and is presented on its own page, which points to continued support.
